title: TV Commercial Costs in 2026: Full Guide - Simulmedia

facts.fact: The page states a 30-second TV commercial ranges from $500 for local spots to $8 million and more for premium placements such as the Super Bowl.
facts.quote: The cost of a 30-second TV commercial ranges from $500 for local spots to $8 million and even more for premium placements like the Super Bowl.
